basic_info.description: Experience city living at its finest in Unit #205 at 18 Lansing Street - a dramatic corner conversion loft with soaring sunny windows, sleek designer updates, and captivating skyline views from almost every room. Legally a 1BD, this loft includes an unwarranted bonus room - the owner previously used it as a home office - paired with its own full bath. The open main level features a light-filled great room for living and dining, a stylish remodeled kitchen with generous cabinetry and breakfast bar, and a full bath with shower-over-tub. A striking spiral staircase ascends to the loft bedroom suite with walk-in closet, en-suite bath, and in-unit laundry. One-car deeded garage parking and extra storage complete the package. Perfectly positioned near BART, MUNI, Caltrain, I-80, and US-101, and just steps from the Financial District, Oracle Park, Chase Center, and The Crossing at East Cut - a vibrant 3.5-block community hub with beer garden, mini soccer fields, fitness zone, and outdoor cinema. Walk Score 95; Transit 100.
